Interior design and fit-out in Dubai runs roughly AED 80–300+ per square foot for the build.
That puts a 750 sq ft one-bed somewhere between AED 60,000 and AED 200,000, and a four-bed villa in Dubai Hills or Jumeirah between AED 350,000 and AED 1.2 million.

First the design fee: design-only work is charged at AED 120–550 per square metre — about AED 11–50 per square foot — or as 8–15% of the build cost, sometimes up to 20% when the firm is supervising a full turnkey job.
Fixed per-room packages run AED 3,000–15,000, and 3D visuals are usually AED 1,500–5,000 per room.
Second the build, which is where the AED 80–300+ per square foot sits: basic and functional at AED 80–150, mid-range at AED 150–300, premium at AED 300–600+.
Worked example: 750 sq ft at AED 160 per square foot is about AED 120,000 for the build, AED 12,000 for design at 10%, and roughly AED 30,000 in furniture.
If someone quotes you AED 120,000 for “everything”, ask which two layers they dropped.
By property, build only: a studio around 450 sq ft lands AED 35,000–120,000.
A 750 sq ft one-bed in Dubai Marina or JVC, AED 60,000–200,000.
An 1,100 sq ft two-bed in Business Bay or Downtown, AED 90,000–330,000.
A townhouse around 2,500 sq ft in Dubai Hills, AED 200,000–650,000.
A four-bed villa near 4,500 sq ft in Al Barsha or Jumeirah, AED 350,000–1.2 million.
Palm Jumeirah and the larger Dubai Hills villas start above AED 1.2 million and climb from there.
